citation: Suzuki K, Watanabe K, Futami-Suda S, et al. The effects of postprandial glucose and insulin levels on postprandial endothelial function in subjects with normal glucose tolerance. Cardiovascular Diabetology. 2012;11:98.
protocol: Test meal 400 kcal (40.7 g carbohydrate, 22.2 g fat) with 500 mL water within 10 min, versus a 75 g glucose OGTT in a separate group, versus no load (control). Blood at 0, 30, 60, 120 min.
population: 37 non-diabetic adults with normal glucose tolerance in 3 groups: control n=11, test meal n=12 (6 men; 28.5 ± 5.1 y; BMI 22.5), OGTT n=14; Japan.

reports.where: Table 2: IRI at 0, 30, 60, 120 min and AUC for the meal and OGTT groups

note: Short and clean: a set meal and an OGTT side by side, with the full insulin time course as SD in one table. The meal and OGTT were given to different people, not as a crossover. Insulin (IRI) is in pmol/L. Meal kinds: mixed meal, OGTT.
